subject: Post-call recap: Data privacy, SOC2 status & console cookie/telemetry mapping - FinPay
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alice Brown <alice.brown@finpay.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Data privacy, SOC2 status & console cookie/telemetry mapping - FinPay

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned. I focused the notes on the compliance items your security team asked about: SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA applicability, and the telemetry / cookie footprint for the Console and docs site.

Summary notes (high level):
- SOC 2: Redwood has an in-progress SOC 2 Type II audit for our production inference platform. We completed readiness and selected the auditor (BlueCove). Expected report Q3 2027.
- Data classification & residency: For FinPay use-cases we recommend Dedicated capacity (VPC) for data isolation; we can also support Customer-managed KMS.
- GDPR/HIPAA: Platform supports features required for both (data subject requests tooling, audit logs, optional PII redaction). We are prepared to execute a HIPAA BAA for covered workflows.
- Console telemetry & docs cookies: Console collects operational telemetry (API call volumes, success/failure counts, latency histograms) and non-PII usage events for UX improvement. Docs site uses a standard analytics cookie and a support chat cookie; we can provide an explicit cookie matrix and opt-out guidance.

Action items / proposed next steps (owners & timing):
1) Neha to provide SOC 2 readiness summary + telemetry cookie matrix (Jonas to add technical detail) — target: Tue 2027-05-25.
2) FinPay to share vendor security questionnaire (if you want us to start filling it) — Alice / Security Team.
3) Schedule a 30-min follow-up with our compliance engineer (Dylan) to walk telemetry details and retention policies — propose Wed 2027-05-26 or Thu 2027-05-27.

Attachments: I don’t have the SOC 2 artifacts yet, but Jonas will attach a short summary and a first-pass cookie/telemetry matrix in his follow-up.

If anything above is off, let me know and I’ll update. Otherwise we’ll treat the dates above as tentative and confirm availability for the technical call.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alice Brown <alice.brown@finpay.com>

Cc: FinPay Security Team <security@finpay.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:14:32 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Data privacy, SOC2 status & console cookie/telemetry mapping - FinPay

Thanks Neha — this is helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side (Security Team copied):

1) SOC 2 evidence: Please share the readiness summary you mentioned and any interim controls documents you can provide now (policy list, evidence locations). We understand the full Type II report is later, but interim artifacts speed our procurement.

2) Telemetry detail: we need a matrix that shows exactly what Console events are collected and whether any tokens/user identifiers are included. Specifically:
   - API call metadata collected (yes/no)
   - Error traces and whether they contain request bodies/keys
   - Retention windows for each telemetry type

3) Cookies on docs.redwood.com: please enumerate cookies, purpose, duration, and whether they are strictly necessary or analytics. Also confirm whether a consent banner is supported for EU visitors.

I have attached our vendor security questionnaire (one PDF). Happy for Redwood to start filling it; if you prefer, we can send an editable XLS. Also let us know if you need a secure upload location for artifacts.

Regards,
Alice Brown
Head of Procurement, FinPay
alice.brown@finpay.com
Attachment: FinPay_Vendor_Security_Q.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Brown <alice.brown@finpay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 08:12:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Data privacy, SOC2 status & console cookie/telemetry mapping - FinPay

Hi Alice —

Jonas here (product security). Following Neha’s recap, I attached two artifacts that should help with FinPay’s review: a one-page SOC 2 readiness summary and a telemetry/cookie matrix that breaks down Console vs Docs site behavior. High-level answers inline to your questions: 

- API call metadata: We collect non-sensitive metadata (endpoint, timestamp, status, latency). We do not log long-lived auth tokens; short-lived request identifiers are used for tracing and expire within 48 hours unless attached to an incident.

- Error traces: Traces may include snippets of request metadata and obfuscated request IDs; request bodies that contain PII are redacted by default. We can configure additional redaction for customer-supplied fields on Dedicated deployments.

- Retention windows:
  * Operational metrics (counts/histograms): retained 13 months by default.
  * Traces and debug logs: retained 90 days; on Dedicated we can set a shorter window.
  * Audit logs (user actions in Console): retained 24 months (exportable).

- Docs cookies: matrix attached (telemetry-cookie-matrix.csv) — short summary: one analytics cookie (ga-like) 13 months, support-chat cookie session-only, cookie consent flag persistent 1 year. Consent banner is supported on our docs site and can be toggled per region.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary of scope & timeline), telemetry-cookie-matrix.csv (detailed list — cookie name, purpose, duration, opt-out mechanism).

Next steps I propose:
- Neha: we can start populating FinPay_Vendor_Security_Q.pdf; if you prefer an editable file, I can request an XLS from your team.
- Dylan: happy to run the technical call on Wed 2027-05-26 10:00 PT (tentative) — will confirm availability.
- We can provision a temporary, read-only S3 bucket (or a secure Drive folder) for evidence uploads. Link below.

Drive evidence folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/finpay/privacy-evidence

Jonas Weber
Product Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, telemetry-cookie-matrix.csv
